rooms.name: The Hall
rooms.description: A narrow hallway runs through the heart of the house. Doors branch off to every room. The front door sits at the far end, daylight outlining its frame.

objects.name: Coat Rack
objects.short_desc: A wooden rack hung with jackets and an umbrella
objects.description: A wooden coat rack hung with a few jackets and an umbrella. Someone left a scarf looped over the top peg.

objects.name: Mirror
objects.short_desc: A tall mirror leaning near the front door
objects.description: A tall mirror leans against the wall near the front door. You look tired.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.description: A comfortable room with a worn sofa facing a large screen. Warm light filters through curtained windows. Bookshelves line the far wall.

objects.name: Sofa
objects.short_desc: A deep worn sofa with mismatched cushions
objects.description: A deep, worn sofa with mismatched cushions. Extremely comfortable.

objects.name: Screen
objects.short_desc: A large flat screen on the wall, currently off
objects.description: A large flat screen mounted on the wall. Currently off. The standby light blinks once every few seconds.

objects.name: Coffee Table
objects.short_desc: A low table scattered with books and an empty mug
objects.description: A low table with a few scattered books and an empty mug. Someone started a crossword puzzle and abandoned it.

objects.name: Bookshelf
objects.short_desc: Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with paperbacks
objects.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with paperbacks and a few framed photos. The titles are a strange mix — travel memoirs beside heavy science texts.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A compact kitchen that smells of coffee. A back door leads out to the yard. Sunlight comes through a small window above the sink.

objects.name: Countertop
objects.short_desc: Countertop with a coffee maker and drying dishes
objects.description: A clean countertop with a coffee maker and a few dishes drying beside the sink. The coffee maker is still warm.

objects.name: Kitchen Table
objects.short_desc: A small round table with two chairs
objects.description: A small round table with two chairs. A newspaper sits folded at one place, unread.

objects.name: Back Door
objects.short_desc: A wooden back door with a small glass panel
objects.description: A plain wooden back door. Through its glass panel you can see the back yard — the vegetable patch, the fence, the trees beyond.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.description: A quiet room with a large bed, curtains drawn against the light. A wardrobe stands against one wall. The bathroom is just through the side door.

objects.name: Bed
objects.short_desc: A large bed with rumpled covers and too many pillows
objects.description: A large bed with rumpled covers and too many pillows. It looks deeply comfortable.

objects.name: Wardrobe
objects.short_desc: A tall wardrobe against the wall
objects.description: A tall wardrobe. Clothes hang inside in approximate order. Something has fallen off a hanger and is pooled at the bottom.

objects.name: Nightstand
objects.short_desc: A small nightstand with a lamp and a face-down paperback
objects.description: A small nightstand with a lamp, a glass of water, and a paperback left face-down at an interesting page.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.description: A small but tidy bathroom. White tiles, a fogged mirror above the sink, and a claw-foot bathtub along the far wall.

objects.name: Bathtub
objects.short_desc: A claw-foot cast-iron tub with a rubber duck on the edge
objects.description: A claw-foot cast-iron tub. Someone has left a rubber duck balanced on the edge. It watches the room with blank approval.

objects.name: Sink
objects.short_desc: A pedestal sink with a fogged mirror above
objects.description: A pedestal sink with a fogged mirror above it. The fog hasn't cleared yet.

objects.name: Medicine Cabinet
objects.short_desc: A small cabinet behind the mirror, politely closed
objects.description: A small cabinet behind the mirror. It is politely closed.

rooms.name: Office
rooms.description: The room is quiet. A wide desk sits beneath the window, its monitor casting a steady green glow over the surface. A floating shelf runs along one wall — the cat sleeps on it, one paw hanging over the edge. A tall bookshelf lines the opposite wall. The door leads back to the hall.

objects.name: Desk
objects.short_desc: A wide desk beneath the window, keyboard and mug on its surface
objects.description: A wide desk positioned beneath the window. Papers, a keyboard, and a steaming mug occupy its surface. The window behind it looks out onto the yard.

objects.name: KleinBOTTLE PC
objects.short_desc: A compact machine glowing a steady green
objects.description: A compact machine on the desk. Its monitor glows a steady green. This is it. This is the computer.

objects.name: Floating Shelf
objects.short_desc: A wall-mounted shelf, mostly occupied by cat
objects.description: A wall-mounted shelf to the left of the desk. The cat fills it completely. The shelf was perhaps not built for this purpose.

objects.name: Window
objects.short_desc: A wide window looking out to the yard and treeline
objects.description: A wide window directly behind the desk. Outside, the yard stretches to the treeline. The light is good in the mornings.

objects.name: Bookshelf
objects.short_desc: A tall shelf packed with manuals, notebooks, and worn novels
objects.description: A tall bookshelf to the right of the desk, packed with technical manuals, notebooks, and a few worn novels. Everything is organised in a system only one person understands.

objects.name: Cat
objects.short_desc: A large tabby, one paw hanging over the edge
objects.description: A large tabby cat occupies the floating shelf like it was built for exactly that purpose. One eye is half-open. It is judging you.

actors.name: Cat
actors.short_desc: A grey tabby curled on the floating shelf, deeply asleep
actors.description: A grey tabby is curled up on the floating shelf, deeply asleep. One paw hangs over the edge. It has been here longer than the shelf.

rooms.name: Front Yard
rooms.description: A neat front yard wraps around the front of the house. Flagstones lead from the front door to a large iron gate in the garden wall. The house stands behind you.

objects.name: Front Gate
objects.short_desc: A large iron gate, slightly rusty at the hinges
objects.description: A large iron gate, slightly rusty at the hinges. It opens with a satisfying clank.

objects.name: Garden Path
objects.short_desc: Flagstones set into neat grass from door to gate
objects.description: Flagstones set into neat grass, running from the front door to the gate. Someone has planted small herbs between the cracks.

rooms.name: Back Yard
rooms.description: A quiet back yard. A vegetable patch runs along the fence. A small wooden gate in the far corner leads into the trees.

objects.name: Back Gate
objects.short_desc: A small wooden gate, worn smooth, well-oiled hinges
objects.description: A small wooden gate, worn smooth. It opens quietly on well-oiled hinges. Beyond it, the trees begin.

objects.name: Vegetable Patch
objects.short_desc: Raised beds with tomatoes, herbs, and leafy unknowns
objects.description: Raised beds with tomatoes, herbs, and something leafy you don't recognise. It smells of earth and growing things.

rooms.name: Wooded Path
rooms.description: A narrow path winds between tall trees. Roots cross the ground, light filters green through the canopy. The path loops around the property — the back of the house is audible through the trees ahead.

objects.name: Old Oak
objects.short_desc: A very old oak with initials carved in bark
objects.description: A very old oak. Its bark is carved with initials too faded to read. The tree doesn't mind.

rooms.name: Wooded Path
rooms.description: The path curves back toward the house. Through the trees you can see the back fence and the small wooden gate. The path continues around to the front if you keep going.

objects.name: Mossy Rock
objects.short_desc: A large flat rock covered in soft moss with a coffee cup
objects.description: A large flat rock covered in soft moss. Someone has left a coffee cup on it. The cup is cold. It has been here a while.

rooms.name: Worn Storage Closet
rooms.description: The broom closet is a cramped space filled with old brooms, dustpans, and boxes of forgotten cleaning supplies. A musty smell permeates the air, and the floor is covered in a layer of dust.

objects.name: broom
objects.description: This is a worn-out broom with a cracked handle and dirty bristles.

objects.name: dustpan
objects.description: This is a plastic dustpan with a slightly yellowed surface and dents from years of use.

objects.name: box_of_cleaning_supplies
objects.description: This is a cardboard box filled with various cleaning items such as sponges, rags, and a few old cleaning solutions.

objects.name: old_rag
objects.description: This is a dirty rag, probably used for mopping floors or wiping surfaces.

objects.name: disposable_bucket
objects.description: This is a plastic bucket with a plastic lid, likely used for quick cleaning tasks.

rooms.name: Bunker Chamber
rooms.description: The worn wooden closet floorboards shift subtly underfoot, hinting at something concealed beneath. Upon closer inspection, you notice faint indentations where a hatch might have been.

objects.name: Hidden Bunker Key
objects.description: A small, tarnished key with a slightly worn surface. It appears to have been around for a long time.

objects.name: Old Map
objects.description: A weathered and slightly yellowed map, marked with cryptic symbols and an old hand writing. It appears to be a detailed view of an area beyond KleinBOTTLE House.

objects.name: Rusty Sword
objects.description: A dull, rusty sword with scabbard still attached. It's not very sharp, but the rust can be seen to be slowly wearing off.

objects.name: Old Letter
objects.description: A torn and crumpled letter with faded ink. The handwriting is difficult to read, but it appears to be a threat or directive of some kind.
